scope: Static research publication; no MCP business or execution authority

presentation.description: A missing-middle traversal graph through pyramids, chemistry and housing: catalogues, conditional connections, evidence gaps and scoped stopping decisions.
presentation.footer: A living research corpus by Aaron Alderman and contributors. The pyramids invite attention; evidence carries the conclusions.

home.title: The Missing Middle: pyramids, chemistry and housing
home.eyebrow: A TRAVERSAL GRAPH OF MISSING MIDDLES
home.headline: Follow the missing middle.
home.deck: Begin with a pyramid observation, a material or a housing need. Chart the possibilities, inspect the connections, and find where evidence opens a path—or tells us to stop.
home.note: The pyramids remain our canonical starting example. A useful modern process can survive the rejection of its proposed ancient use.
home.imageAlt: Schematic pyramid cutaway showing the connecting layers of material, process, surviving trace and historical inference. It is an illustration, not a reconstruction.
home.orientation: Pyramids, chemistry and housing are the first three regions of a broader search. Their catalogues expose options and gaps; each connection keeps its conditions, evidence, strongest rival and stopping rule.
home.spineTitle: All the way down. All the way back.
home.spineDescription: Descend from the monument to the physical mechanism. Return through predictions, measurements and preserved traces. Each change of description has to account for what it keeps and what it loses.
home.exampleEyebrow: A REAL DETECTOR TO STRUCTURE BRIDGE
home.exampleTitle: Seeing a corridor is one question. Explaining it is another.
home.exampleDescription: Muon observations characterized a corridor-shaped structure in Khufu’s Pyramid. A geometric record can be strong while questions about construction sequence and function still require different evidence.
home.closingTitle: The interesting work lives between the boxes.
home.closingDescription: Chemistry, geology, geophysics and archaeology overlap. The corpus preserves their connecting mechanisms, assumptions, alternatives and tests so another person can continue the work.
home.workedTitle: Follow the evidence through the middle.
home.workedDescription: Eighteen worked studies ground selected parts of the graph. They retain source observations, conditional calculations and unresolved decisions; they do not exhaust the design space.

sections.title: The scientific objects
sections.copy: The existing twelve-coordinate kernel, typed candidate relations, joint inputs, negative constraints and unresolved questions remain explicit. A grammatical connection does not establish a physical or historical claim.

sections.title: The interface is decomposed too
sections.copy: Every generated native page is checked by the retained Sourcery surface-composition and native-lowering mechanisms. Controls come from a declared collection grammar. The prose region is imported Markdown and retains an explicit rendering boundary.

sections.title: The existing mechanisms are retained
sections.copy: This publication reuses the common-algebra interpreter, component library, collection controls, native lowering and static serializer. Source hashes identify the retained bytes and the serializer extraction.

links.label: Read the reuse and authority decisions

sections.title: Composition has an authority ceiling
sections.copy: A record-level path can carry types, assumptions, losses and evidence into a reading projection. The attempted jump from publication to a confirmed ancient process is rejected by the retained composer.

links.label: Inspect the common-algebra composition and refusal

sections.title: Worked evidence and reproducible calculations
sections.copy: The worked layer distinguishes synthetic scenarios, conditional calculations, source-reported measurement transcriptions and arithmetic derived from those measurements. All use the existing twelve-coordinate kernel. No result supplies unmeasured rates, analytical uncertainty or historical dates.

sections.title: Variation analysis in action
sections.copy: The pyramid-centred demonstration carries constrained compositions, nuisance factors, factorial contrasts, sensitivity surfaces and production bottlenecks through the same research-step and calculation records. Synthetic responses and timings supply no experimental or historical authority.

sections.title: A source-to-calculation audit
sections.copy: The Lauer dossier preserves source-reported specimen identities and five located SEM–EDS entries. Arithmetic on printed values is reproducible; raw spectra, measurement errors and historical dates are not manufactured. Coverage is assessed on separate axes rather than collapsed into a readiness score.

sections.title: Construction and decision records
sections.copy: Components, histories and decisions reuse the twelve-coordinate kernel, epistemic-claim fields and existing collection grammar. Context dependencies retain their identities; ordered process chains do not automatically acquire empirical authority. The numerical adapter exposes the assumptions and losses of each cross-scale or engineering transformation.

sections.title: Interfaces and product-declaration boundaries
sections.copy: Source phase assessments, Roman preparation contexts and product LCA declarations retain different record kinds. Pure-phase mass balances concern physical species; GWP-total is a characterized lifecycle indicator, not conserved CO₂ mass. Missing assembly totals remain null and module D stays separate. No new runtime or scientific admission is added.

sections.title: Traversal graph and finite search atlases
sections.copy: Atlas axes are overlapping facets. Atomic work retains the original O1–O9 partition and every graph record receives the unchanged twelve-coordinate kernel. Relations preserve conjunctive prerequisites. Ordered routes are source-authored reading paths, not a new solver or physical derivation; connection status never satisfies a missing prerequisite.

traversalHub.title: A traversal graph of missing middles
traversalHub.deck: Begin anywhere. Chart the possibilities, inspect each connecting step, and follow the evidence to a useful next question or a scoped stopping point.
traversalHub.boundary: This is a finite search map with grounded examples and explicit gaps. A missing edge means not catalogued here. A generated candidate is not a discovery. No path automatically establishes a scientific or engineering conclusion.
traversalHub.connectionsTitle: Inspect the middle, not just the endpoints
dispositions: Advance only within the supported conditions.
Seek the observation that can distinguish the strongest rivals.
Hold alternatives that current evidence cannot distinguish.
Reject a scoped implication or process variant, with a reason.
Stop an investigation whose attainable outcomes cannot change the decision.
Open another missing middle when a new coupling or unresolved carrier appears.
